prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / 3D website world for side-by-side style comparison.
Reference1: the USER-REQUESTED Mario-like 3D original mascot lineup. This is the STRICT character identity and rendering guide: rounded big noses, white gloves, blue oval eyes, big shoes, green / orange / blue / yellow clothes and specific props.
Reference2: the recently liked PIXEL ART concept sheet. Use ONLY its LOWER school scene as the composition/layout/content guide. Ignore the upper four-character roster; output NO roster. We are making a 3D-rendered version of that SAME school world to fairly compare 3D vs pixel website designs.
Create ONE full-width wide landscape school-campus illustration, approx 12:5 ratio (2.4:1), with the same distant viewpoint, buildings, activity areas and people scale as the lower panorama in reference2. NO close-up foreground giants. No words, titles, UI, watermarks, labels, roster strip or split panels.

SCENE COMPOSITION MATCH:
Sky and tree line across top; blue-roofed cream gymnasium upper left; cream schoolhouse with blue roof and clock tower upper right; low simple school fence behind activity areas. Wide warm yellow-sand schoolyard. Four activity groups arranged left to right:
- Far left open-front classroom alcove, green chalkboard, little semicircle of desks, green 学活くん facilitating class discussion with small seated classmates.
- Left center sports-day red entry arch and bunting, oval white running track, 3 classmates running a baton relay, orange 行人 with white headband and yellow flag cheering beside the track; a row of 5-6 cheering children toward lower middle-left.
- Right center noticeboard and small raised platform, blue 児童会ちゃん holding microphone with yellow diagonal sash and two dark side hair buns, 6 pupils participating on stools facing her at slight angles.
- Far right yellow クラブマン with blue headband, white outlined star and short red-orange cape, several pupils painting at easel, making a paper/wood toy plane, playing a small drum and watering a flowerbed.
Foreground gate left, small bench with red-white cap and schoolbag lower middle, schoolyard water tap nearby, rectangular flowerbed lower right.
Around 28-34 small pupils in total, the four principal mascots only 10-13% of image height, background pupils 7-10%. Coherent little school activities at a distance. All people complete, no severed bodies/limbs, all main props within frame, not an overcrowded picture. Preserve wide game-map framing rather than character portraits. Clear faces when zoomed.

CHARACTER IDENTITIES MUST MATCH REFERENCE1:
Green boy: green tunic with short cream vertical neck placket, green shorts, green/cream oversized rounded shoes, white gloves, large round nose, friendly big blue eyes, short dark hair, little white card with green lines.
Orange boy: orange shirt with horizontal white stripe, white headband, orange shorts and shoes, white gloves, short dark hair, yellow triangular flag.
Blue girl: blue A-line dress, yellow sash, 2 low round hair buns, blue shoes, white gloves, small rounded nose, handheld microphone.
Yellow boy: sunny yellow top/shorts, white star outlined dark on chest, blue headband, short orange cape, big yellow shoes, white gloves, energetic friendly grin.
All supporting pupils in same Mario-like original human-shaped character family, no actual Mario/Luigi, no animal mascots.

RENDERING:
Polished cheerful console-platform-game 3D promotional illustration matching reference1. Expertly modeled clean rounded shapes, gentle bevels, broad controlled highlights and soft cast shadows, vivid simple primary-color surfaces, appealing high clarity. Buildings and trees have crafted rounded toy-like geometry, slightly exaggerated roof thickness, broad smooth leaves, no photo-texture noise, no felt or clay grain. Soft sunny daylight, clean blue sky, all depth in focus; NO cinematic bokeh. The game world should feel tactile and welcoming. Preserve simple strong colors and school familiarity; no fantasy mushrooms, pipes, coins, question blocks, logos or princess castles.
This is explicitly a 3D comparison version of the SAME campus as the pixel reference, not a new visual layout.
